description.value: OPA! of Greece is a Canadian Greek quick-service restaurant chain operating since 1998, serving souvlaki, pita wraps, gyros, calamari, and Greek salads. It is one of the largest Greek QSR chains in North America, with numerous BC locations. A touring cyclist would find familiar, filling Greek-inspired fast food with both dine-in and takeout options.
